articles.title: Germany moves to tax bitcoin like stocks as new draft bill targets tax-free gains
articles.snippet: Existing holdings would keep the current tax treatment, which can allow tax-free sales after a 12-month holding period.

articles.title: Hunter Biden defends LAPTOP ahead of Wednesday launch, calls TRUMP a ‘grift’
articles.snippet: Biden says the token is about “resilience, redemption and recovery” and will give coins to nearly one million wallets that lost money on TRUMP.

articles.title: Moonshot’s Kimi rattled markets. U.S. agencies now say it was trained on American models
articles.snippet: Moonshot, whose Kimi model rattled markets earlier this year, is among six Chinese AI firms accused of systematically extracting capabilities from U.S. models.

articles.title: Hunter Biden’s laptop controversy gets a memecoin afterlife
articles.snippet: The project’s disclosures say LAPTOP has no utility, lock founder tokens for six months and reserve 2% for wallets that lost money on TRUMP.

articles.title: Gemini receives Singapore payment license for crypto services
articles.snippet: Gemini’s local entity is authorized to provide digital payment token and cross-border money transfer services without standard transaction-volume limits.
